p: candle shined upon my head: When I felt his favour.
darkness: I was free from affliction.
secret of God was upon my: That is, seemed by evident tokens to be more present with me.
with butter: By these comparisons he declares the great prosperity that he was in, so that he had no opportunity to be such a sinner as they accused him.
hid themselves: Being ashamed of their lightness and afraid of my gravity.
ear heard me: All that heard me, praised me.
poor that cried: Because his adversaries did so much charge him with wickedness, he is compelled to render account of his life.
The blessing of him that was: That is, I helped him who was in distress, and so he had cause to praise me.
righteousness: I delighted to do justice, as others did to wear costly apparel.
nest: That is, at home in my bed without all trouble and unquietness.
spread out by the waters: My happiness increases.
dropped upon them: That is, was pleasant to them.
as for the latter rain: As the dry ground thirsts for the rain.
laughed on them: That is, they thought it not to be a rest, or they did not think that I would condescend to them.
cast not down: They were afraid to offend me and cause me to be angry.
their way: I had them at commandment.
